text: The Statue of Liberty is 46 m from base to torch: too short to make this list.
China now curbs statues over 30 m. Jingzhou took down its 58 m Guan Yu in 2021-22.
Japan has 9 statues on this list, but the newest of them went up back in 1994.
4 statues here were unveiled since 2022: in India, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia.
Spring Temple Buddha is often listed at 128 m. That includes its 20 m lotus throne.
Next: the Statue of Unity, 66 m taller than any other statue on Earth.
